# HackIEEE 2026-27

> The premier national hackathon hosted by IEEE Computer Society at Nirma University. 48 hours to innovate, build, and ship considered code with cutting-edge tools and technologies.

- **Event Name:** HackIEEE 2026-27 (Inaugural Edition)
- **Tagline:** Build, stage and ship code that feels considered, from first draft to launch.
- **Dates:** 
  - Registrations Open: November 15, 2026
  - Problem Statements & Track Declaration: December 20, 2026
  - Grand Offline Finale: January 2–4, 2027 (36-hour offline hackathon)
- **Venue:** Nirma University, Sarkhej - Gandhinagar Highway, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382481, India
- **Format:** In-person / Offline Grand Finale at Nirma University campus
- **Team Size:** 1 to 4 members per team
- **Eligibility:** Open to students, developers, and tech innovators globally
- **Registration Fee:** Free of cost
- **Official Website:** https://hack.ieeenirma.org
- **Primary Contact:** deep@computer.org | +91 92656 41668
- **Organizers:** IEEE Computer Society Student Branch Chapter at Nirma University (with IEEE ITSS & IEEE SPS)
- **Collaborator:** Kiro (https://kiro.dev)

## Schedule & Timeline

1. **Phase 0 — Registrations Open (November 15, 2026):**
   Team formation begins. Global registration portal opens for all participants.
2. **Phase 1 — Problem Statement & Track Declaration (December 20, 2026):**
   Official challenge tracks and problem statements unveiled. Shortlisted teams confirmed.
3. **Phase 2 — Grand Finale (January 2–4, 2027):**
   36-hour offline hackathon, mentorship sessions, project pitching, judging, and award ceremony at Nirma University.

## Core Pillars & Values

- **Build & Ship:** Transform ambitious concepts into production-grade functional software and hardware within 48 hours.
- **Connect & Network:** Engage with tech founders, industry mentors, IEEE leaders, and peers from across the nation.
- **Learn & Grow:** Hands-on workshops, masterclasses, and direct exposure to modern architectures, frameworks, and tools.
